body:
Part of #114; split out under the reopening comment's instruction to ship all requirements or create linked follow-ups. PR #116 adds Safari and Safari Technology Preview cookies only.

Implement Safari/Safari Technology Preview non-cookie sources with identical options and reports in JS, Python and Rust:

- Bookmarks.plist (binary and XML plists), including reading-list entries; translate hierarchy to each target's supported format.
- History.db through a read-only SQLite snapshot, preserving visits and applying domains filtering.
- Safari / Passwords app Export Passwords CSV: explicit CSV input, quoted fields and UTF-8, domain filtering, target-side encryption, and actionable instructions instead of direct iCloud Keychain extraction.
- Safari's container LocalStorage/IndexedDB readers, covered together with #114's new data-class work.
- Discover modern Safari named profiles/WebsiteDataStore paths and distinguish them from the conventional container and legacy cookie stores supported by #116. Prefer the active supported store over a stale legacy store.
- Report unsupported Safari preferences/extensions with reasons; never feed Safari files to Chromium readers.

Acceptance: synthetic binarycookies/plist/sqlite/CSV fixtures, domains-filter tests, source immutability, Full Disk Access errors, installed/default/custom source tests, native cross-language parity and per-class generated matrix entries. Document macOS versions tested and unsupported formats explicitly. Follow the target-engine issue for Firefox/WebKit output.
title: Complete Safari non-cookie import sources and modern profile discovery (#114)
